ModulePrefs.author: weelookang@gmail.com; Francisco Esquembre; Felix J. Garcia Clemente
ModulePrefs.description: Title: Interactive R0 simulation Purpose: To self-create a simple interactive simulation to explain R0 which is a new LO. If successful, this can be incorporated into an existing SLS lesson Yongkuan has created for this new LO. There is an existing animation here: https://media.hhmi.org/biointeractive/click/modeling- disease-spread/advanced-spread.html But would be good to make one that students can adjust the numbers and see the animation/numbers change. At the same time, possible to also create a graph (at the side) showing numbers of individuals infected over time as the animation is playing?
